content: The execution was successful with a reward of 1.0. The strategy of merging text runs within each paragraph (<hp:p>) before performing placeholder substitution effectively handled the common HWPX issue where templates are split across multiple XML tags (e.g., `<hp:t>{{</hp:t><hp:t>key</hp:t><hp:t>}}</hp:t>`). Additionally, the removal of the `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements ensured that the HWP viewer would recalculate the layout rather than using stale, overlapping character positions. This approach provides a robust template for future HWPX-based automation tasks.
